projectDescription: A self-deployable, ad-free browser game site with 147+ embedded games, website proxies, movie streaming, and tab-cloaking utilities — designed for easy customization and self-hosting.
keyFeatures: 147+ embedded browser games accessible from one site
Website proxy panel with tabs for YouTube, Discord, Spotify, and more
Movie streaming integration via embedded iframe
Tab cloaker: rename browser tab title and favicon via localStorage
about:blank window opener for additional stealth browsing
Live search filtering for both games and apps
No ads, no tracking — fully client-side
Animated rainbow glow button effects and glassmorphism UI
Fully customizable via JSON config files
publicApiSurface: config/games.json — array of { title, link, imgSrc } game entries
config/apps.json — array of { title, link, imgSrc } website proxy entries
js/main.js — localStorage title/icon cloaking applied globally on page load
js/misc.js — changeTabTitle(), changeTabIcon(), resetTabSettings(), applyUrl(url, title)
js/subtitle.js — getRandomGreeting() returns a random subtitle string
misc.html — about:blank opener and tab cloaker UI
projects.html — game library with live search
apps.html — website proxy panel with live search
